name: IPv6 6in4 Tunnel Broker
description: Free IPv6 6in4 (SIT) tunnels from a tunnel broker such as tunnelbroker.net or route64.org. The broker hands you a client IPv6 address, a broker endpoint and a routed prefix; this plugin configures the kernel tunnel, addresses and routes from those values in a generated systemd unit, with no package to install. Optional endpoint updates follow Hurricane Electric's documented dyndns2 API: the update call sends this appliance's current public IPv4 address and its stored update key to the broker — a third-party service. Disabling the plugin tears the tunnel down and removes the unit.
